renderings.value: Lists multiple attributes or actions applying to the same subject: 'both…and…', 'not only…but also…'.

「～も～ば～も～」 is used when describing multiple characteristics or actions. It often appears with the conditional form (ば) plus も, indicating that 'A is true, and also B is true.' For example, 'He can do X, and he can also do Y.' It's different from '～ば～ほど', which means 'the more… the more…'.
Noun/Verb/Adjective + も + (Verb/Adjective in ば-form) + も + (Verb/Adjective)
も～ば～も: both X and Y (勉強もできればスポーツもできる).
He is good at studying and also at sports.
This restaurant is cheap, and the food is also good.
She plays both the piano and the guitar.
In life, there are both fun times and tough times.
